theme_overview.name: Ethereal Glassmorphism
theme_overview.description: A modern, futuristic, yet romantic Gen-Z wedding aesthetic. Features a bright soft pink palette, beautiful glass effects (crystal glassmorphism), and gently moving aesthetic flowers to create an immersive, ethereal experience. The vibe is 'kekinian', fun, but heavily romantic.

typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' mixed with 'Youthful Energy'. Elegant high-contrast serif for headings to feel romantic and luxurious, paired with a geometric clean sans-serif for body to keep it modern, young, and readable.

headings.usage: Use for all H1, H2, and massive text blocks. Apply tracking-tighter for a modern look.

body.usage: Use for all paragraphs, UI elements, and button text.

accent.usage: Use sparingly for beautiful romantic pull quotes or large decorative section numbers.

hierarchy.small_labels: text-xs tracking-[0.2em] uppercase font-sans font-semibold text-pink-600

glassmorphism.rules: Never use complete transparency over images. Ensure text contrast. For heavy overlapping items, add a subtle inner white border (1px).

animated_flowers.implementation: Create abstract SVG flower/petal components. Position them absolute across the hero and section gaps. Use framer-motion to animate 'y' (floating up/down slowly) and 'rotate' (gentle twisting). Use opacity-30 to opacity-50 so they don't distract from content.

logo_treatment.instruction: The provided logo in /app/assets/image-4.png is white/low contrast. To make it contrasting pink against the soft background, use CSS mask-image approach: a div with background-color of brand pink (e.g. bg-rose-600), and mask-image set to the logo URL. Alternatively, use CSS filters: brightness(0) saturate(100%) invert(24%) sepia(87%) saturate(3061%) hue-rotate(334deg) brightness(91%) contrast(98%).

buttons.primary: rounded-full bg-rose-600 text-white font-medium hover:bg-rose-700 transition-all shadow-lg hover:shadow-rose-600/25 hover:-translate-y-0.5
buttons.secondary: rounded-full backdrop-blur-md bg-white/50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-800 font-medium hover:bg-white/80 transition-all

cards.package_card: Apply glassmorphism.default. Add rounded-3xl. For 'Premium' or recommended, add an animated border gradient or use glassmorphism.heavy.
cards.testimonial_card: rounded-2xl bg-white/50 backdrop-blur-sm p-6 border border-white/60

marquee.text_style: text-2xl font-serif italic tracking-wider uppercase px-4

inputs.style: bg-white/60 backdrop-blur-sm border-rose-200 focus:border-rose-400 focus:ring-rose-400 rounded-xl

whatsapp_popup.style: fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-50 rounded-2xl glassmorphism.heavy p-4 flex flex-col gap-3 shadow-2xl border-white

grids_layouts.spacing_system: Generous spacing. Use py-24 or py-32 for sections. Container px-6 md:px-12.
grids_layouts.hero: min-h-screen relative flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden. Hero image as absolute background object (w-full h-full object-cover), but overlaid heavily with bg-pink-50/70 backdrop-blur-sm so the massive pink logo and CTA pop on top.
grids_layouts.bento_grid: For packages: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Stretch to h-full.

motion.page_load: All elements must have entrance animations. Use framer-motion staggered fade-up for texts and cards.
motion.scroll: Parallax effect on the hero image (moves slower than scroll).
motion.flowers: Continuous slow float (y: [0, -20, 0], transition: { repeat: Infinity, duration: 8, ease: 'easeInOut' }).
motion.hover: Scale cards slightly (1.02), buttons translate Y.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure pink-900 text on pink-50/white background meets 4.5:1 ratio. Glass components MUST have white/solid fallbacks or sufficient opacity so text underneath doesn't blend.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the continuous flower floating.
accessibility.test_ids: Apply data-testid to all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='package-booking-btn', data-testid='admin-login-submit').

media.treatment: All photos should have rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl corners unless full bleed. Add a subtle pink-tinted shadow (shadow-rose-900/10) to images.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design a stunning, youthful, modern romantic landing page and admin dashboard based on these rules.
Use Framer Motion to create 'floating aesthetic flowers' (can be simple inline SVGs like petals or 4-leaf blossoms) that move gently in the background of the hero and spacer sections.

Implement endless running text using react-fast-marquee. Fill it with youthful wedding phrases: 'RAW CONTENT IN 24 HOURS • UNLIMITED FOOTAGE • TREN KEKINIAN • CAPTURE YOUR MOMENT • ESTETIK & ROMANTIS'.

For the hero section, place the image-3.jpg as the background, but add a glass/white/pink heavy overlay so it feels 'ethereal'. Inside this hero, display the massive logo (image-4.png) heavily masked or CSS-filtered into a bright contrasting pink.

Implement the 'Masuk sebagai admin' discreetly in the footer. The admin dashboard should use a cleaner, denser variation of the glassmorphism theme, containing a calendar widget to manage slots and a table for bookings.

Auto-calculate distance from Bekasi in the booking form: Mock this functionality, but design the UI to show 'Jarak dari Bekasi: X km' and 'Biaya Transport: Rp Y'. Highlight this functionality is MOCKED.
Create beautiful Glassmorphic cards for the 4 packages (Basic 150k, Classic 250k, Special 350k, Premium 650k).
Ensure the tone of the copy in the UI is 'asyik tapi romantis' (young, fresh, but sweet).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) and 1px semi-transparent borders.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, with interaction animations.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
